chars.T: T: a strict woman teacher wearing a long burgundy cardigan over a cream blouse, a black ankle-length skirt and thin gold glasses
chars.B: B: a 12-year-old boy wearing a bright yellow hoodie with a navy front pocket, blue jeans and red sneakers
chars.K: K: a few schoolchildren classmates in plain grey and light-blue clothes sitting at old wooden desks

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: T stands angrily next to B's desk with her arms crossed, staring down at B, who looks up at her worried; classmates K turn around to watch. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: B sits at his desk with his head bowed low in shame, hands in his lap, silent, while classmates K around him stare at him. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: T leans forward shouting with her mouth wide open and points her finger angrily at B, who shrinks back in his chair, scared. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: T stands over B and pulls him up by the ear, B winces in pain, half standing from his desk. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: B stands stiffly beside his desk, nervous, eyes on the floor, while T stands in front of him with her hands on her hips, waiting impatiently. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: B whispers with his hand cupped near his mouth, looking around in fear, and T leans in, her eyes widening in shock. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: T drags B by the arm to stand in front of the green chalkboard facing the whole class K; B looks terrified. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: B stands alone in front of the chalkboard with tears in his eyes, while classmates K laugh and point at him from their desks. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: T points sharply from B toward the class, commanding him to say it loud; B trembles with his mouth tightly closed, tears on his cheeks. Setting: a Moroccan public middle-school classroom with a green chalkboard, worn wooden desks and a barred window.
